verdict.rationale: Xero offers a broad REST API, OpenAPI spec, SDKs, and even an MCP server for AI agents, showing strong API-first openness. However, the MCP server's documented capabilities (contacts, chart of accounts, invoices) are far narrower than the full UI feature set (multi-currency, reconciliation, bill pay, reporting, JAX AI tools), and no llms.txt exists, suggesting the API/AI layer doesn't yet cover everything achievable in the UI.
